name: Destination Education: Let's Learn!
source:
The game's sorta half baked, with its fair share of mistakes because it was made in under 3 days. Sorry about that. My next game will have more love and effort poured into it to ensure a better gaming experience.

A short visual novel inspired by Baldi's Basics and radio.Signal!

[from [url=https://burnberry.itch.io/destination-education-lets-learn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这款游戏还处于半成品状态，其中存在相当多的错误，因为它是在不到3天的时间内制作完成的。对此感到抱歉。我的下一款游戏将会投入更多的爱和精力，以确保更好的游戏体验。

一部简短的视觉小说，灵感来自巴尔迪的基础知识和广播。信号！

[来自[url=https://burnberry.itch.io/destination-education-lets-learn]itch.io[/url]]
